'''Hazard Vault 451''' was a secure storage facility located underneath the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. A cache of prototype weapons was stored in the vault, and [[Brel Orus]] did not inform the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] of their existence.
